criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: One floodlit night world with measured frames (3 at 3.0 to 1, 6 at scale, 4 with five enclosures); 6 a bar chart on an empty plate, 8 a loaf on a tablecloth, 2 primitive kit bodies, 5's flat tape and crate, 4's lit door shows a car, 9 the greyest wall.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, one accent meaning; camera move, lit and dark motif and the reversed close work; the reliefs sit a step outside; the close lifts.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral checked against the extraction; every round 1 and 2 repair verified. Looser points: 'humanoid robot' rests on c22's software sentence rather than a row quote; Megapack drawn as a door in the same wall as the vehicle lines; slide 4 says 'drawn here' rather than 'drawn to illustrate'; 'still under construction' stretches 'continued construction'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What and who are clear; no county, deadline or action; a general stake.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 5 turns, 9 lands; 2 and 3 repeat a figure; 6 and 7 are detours.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean on every surface; a careful reader paraphrasing a filing.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat; new world after three lastLight decks; taped empty bays repeat no. 56.

one_sentence_fix: Fetch where each Texas row sits and NHTSA's next step before storyboarding.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A diagram on an empty grey plate; flat 400 MW strip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the scale so the groove runs edge to edge, milled with lit and shadowed walls.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A loaf on a tablecloth; straight skirt hem; disc wheels.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cover pulled in under the sills and around the arches; camera at 0.9 m three quarter.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive kit bodies; wheels floating on blocks.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three quarter crossover catching the rim light; tyres seated with contact.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The lamp pool misses the bolts; flat tape; one flat crate face.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Aim the lamp pool onto the near bolt group; strap and bevel the crate.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A car in the lit door behind the Megapack row; empty upper frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: An enclosure in that door; camera toward 1.0 m.
